purpose: Engineering screen for whether factorized approximate prefix reuse preserves chained CEM decisions closely enough to justify a 10-case shadow closed-loop run.
claim_boundary: This is an engineering screen, not a statistical non-inferiority proof and not evidence of population-level decision equivalence.

observations.independence_unit: independent Wall observation with its own complete chained CEM run
observations.required_ids: Exactly 10 unique observation_id values in decision.jsonl.

fixed_settings.objective: Use the existing DINO-WM Wall planner objective without modification.
fixed_settings.tie_break: Use the existing stable candidate-index tie-break.
fixed_settings.checkpoint_and_preprocessing: Identical checkpoint, evaluation mode, preprocessing, action bounds, and initial observation for both paths.

decision_gate.record_unit: one independent observation containing all 10 chained CEM rounds

round_schema.noise_rule: The baseline and factorized_cache paths must reset to the same planner noise schedule seed before the planner call. DINO-WM samples CEM noise with CPU torch.randn and then transfers it to CUDA; the seed identifies the whole paired schedule, not an individual CUDA draw.
round_schema.chain_rule: For round r>0, each path input_mu and input_sigma must equal that same path's actual mu and sigma from round r-1. Round 0 inputs must be recorded for both paths and equal each other.
round_schema.topk_rule: topk_indices must contain 30 unique integer candidate indices in [0,299]. topk_set_overlap is the set intersection size divided by 30.
round_schema.difference_rule: mu_max_abs_diff, sigma_max_abs_diff, first_action_max_abs_diff, and first_action_l2_diff are recomputed from the recorded baseline and factorized_cache arrays; all must be finite.

decision_gate.pass_rule: PASS only when exactly 10 observations each have exactly 10 chained rounds, every round has topk set overlap=1 and mu/sigma max absolute differences <=1e-5, and all 10 final-round first-action max absolute differences <=1e-5. The L2 difference is reported and checked for finiteness but is diagnostic, not an additional gate.
decision_gate.failure_rule: Missing, duplicated, non-finite, non-paired, non-chained, or threshold-violating records fail the decision screen.

latency_subset.selection: Exactly two observation_id values drawn from the 10 decision-screen observations.

timing.timing_boundary: Complete planner call from entry through returned first action
timing.device_synchronization: CUDA synchronize immediately before timing and immediately after timing
timing.path_order_policy_field: path_order_policy must equal interleaved_seeded and path_order_seed must be recorded as a scalar identifier

system_gate.latency_statistic: For each latency-subset planner call and path, take the median of its 10 technical repeats. Report the median of the two paired reductions, reduction = 1 - median(factorized_latency)/median(baseline_latency).

latency_gate.rule: Paired median latency reduction must be at least 20%.

system_gate.memory_statistic: For each latency-subset planner call and path, take the maximum peak_memory_mib over technical repeats. Compare the maximum factorized-to-baseline ratio across the two calls.

memory_gate.rule: Peak memory ratio must be at most 1.10.

system_gate.pass_rule: PASS only when exactly two observations have complete paired records for both paths, metadata and CUDA synchronization policy match, the latency gate passes, and the memory gate passes.

authorization.shadow_closed_loop: Authorized only if decision_gate and system_gate both PASS.
authorization.shadow_scope: 10-case Wall shadow closed-loop with identical initial states, goals, seeds, and candidate/noise schedule; compare actions and success without using the approximate path to silently replace the baseline reference.
authorization.not_authorized_on: Any missing/failed decision or system gate, or any incomplete pairing.

result_files.system: JSON summary with timing metadata and records array

prohibited: Do not reset mu or sigma between chained CEM rounds.
Do not use different planner noise schedule seeds between paired paths.
Do not substitute independent fresh CEM runs for chained runs.
Do not include environment interaction in planner latency.
Do not claim statistical non-inferiority, closed-loop success, or population-level equivalence from this screen alone.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for recorded values or comparisons.
